enchantments.tooltip: Shocking Blow: This item is charged with electricity. When in melee, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a large electric shock (10 to 60 electric damage). A successful Reflex save (DC 22) reduces this damage by half.
Strength +4: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Electric Resistance +14: Passive: +14 Enhancement bonus to your Electric Resistance.
